profile.summary: Ion Exchange (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides water and environmental management solutions in India and internationally. It operates through Engineering, Chemicals, and Consumer Products segments. The company offers raw water, process, post, and drinking water treatment; waste water, water recycling, and zero liquid discharge systems; sludge dewatering and waste to energy
